item.title: Fed's Hammack tells PBS there's still time to weigh next monetary policy move
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that the September US employment report fits with the recent trend of hiring, noting she has time before she has to make a decision on what is next for monetary policy. The September jobs report, which showed a [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"seemingly weak"] 29,000 hiring gain and a move up in the unemployment rate to 4.2%, fits in with the recent performance of the sector, Hammack said in an interview with the PBS News Hour program. “On average, what we've seen over the past 12 months is 41,000 new jobs being created each month. That's largely in line with my estimate of what the break-even is” for the sector, which in turn suggests a trend of stability for the hiring sector, Hammack said. Regarding how the Fed should react with monetary policy, Hammack said, “We'll still have a lot of information before our meeting at the end of the month, and so there's a lot of time to make a decision about what the right stance of policy is to make sure we're delivering on both sides of our mandate.” Hammack has been a steadfast and early supporter of raising rates to lower inflation pressures that she and her central bank colleagues consider too high. This week, a number of key Fed officials said the Fed [USN:S0N44V01O TEXT:"has time"] to weigh the data before raising rates again. The Fed last month hiked its interest rate target by a quarter percentage point, to between 3.75% and 4%, as officials penciled in expectations of another increase before year-end. The [USN:SPN45L011 TEXT:"comments"] from officials this week indicated no rate action is likely at the Federal Open Market Committee meeting scheduled for Oct. 27-28.

item.title: 'Handful' of G20 countries reject US stance on excess industrial capacity
item.description: A "handful" of Group of 20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies.
item.dc:creator: David Lawder
item.content:encoded: A "handful" of Group of 20 trade ministers rejected US calls to curb excess industrial capacity and "non-market" policies, the US Trade Representative's office said on Friday, exposing divisions within the group of major economies. The US, this year's G20 chair, issued the statement a day after a [USN:L1N45N131 TEXT:"trade meeting in Milwaukee"] that revealed that only two countries — Mexico and Argentina — signed on to a US-led statement calling for more work and cooperation to eliminate mgoods produced with forced labor from supply chains. The rejection from the vast majority of G20 countries follows the Trump administration's imposition of tariffs of 10% or 12.5% on goods from 59 countries and the European Union over allegations that they fail to adequately enforce bans on forced labor. USTR also is conducting a second "Section 301" tariff investigation into 16 trading partners that show signs of excess industrial capacity. The probe is widely expected to lead to new duties in coming months. The USTR statement did not name countries that objected to the excess-capacity statement. But China had [USN:L1N44T0JC TEXT:"objected"] to a similar G20 statement denouncing forced labor and non-market economic policies that lead to excessive exports at a finance leaders' meeting a month ago in North Carolina. "The draft ministerial statement was supported by all but a handful of members, a few of whom firmly rejected creating this pathway toward cooperative action" on excess capacity, the statement said, adding that this "severely disappointed" the US G20 presidency. China's excess industrial capacity and industrial subsidies have been key themes of the US-led G20 ministerial meetings so far this year. Beijing has rejected claims that its industrial policies have created excess capacity, accusing Western countries of using the issue to justify protectionist measures. The US said that G20 trade ministers reached consensus on denouncing the weaponization of food trade, with members agreeing that trade in food or agricultural inputs should not be used as a tool for economic or political coercion. In that G20 joint statement, the ministers defined the weaponization of food as measures to "slow, stop, block or direct the flow of food and agricultural inputs" to exert coercive pressure to extract unrelated geopolitical concessions. "We condemn food weaponization, as it poses a significant humanitarian and economic threat," the G20 trade ministers said. After pressure from US President Donald Trump that included the threat of a US diesel export ban, Group of Seven countries on Friday [USN:B5N44301Y TEXT:"agreed to release"] some 100 million barrels of diesel reserves to try to drive down record-high US diesel prices. The fuel is widely used in agricultural production. TARIFF STRUCTURE DISCUSSIONS US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Thursday that he did not seek a joint statement on a fourth discussion topic, reforming the "most favored nation" system of published, unconditional global tariff rates that underpin the World Trade Organization. MFN tariffs have defined the global trading system since the end of World War Two. Greer has argued that the MFN principle has been abused by non-market-oriented economies such as China that have subsidized industries, but it does not allow these countries to be treated differently. The US statement said some G20 members had expressed a willingness to consider changes to MFN, including expanding exceptions to the principle and issuing new legal interpretations to enable greater use of existing exceptions.

item.title: Tribunal de apelações dos EUA bloqueia lei de Minnesota contra fotos com nudez simulada por IA em processo da xAI
item.description: A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A xAI de Elon Musk conseguiu nesta sexta-feira que um tribunal federal de apelações dos EUA suspendesse a proibição do Estado de Minnesota — a primeira do país — relativa a imagens falsas de nudez geradas por IA, enquanto a empresa de tecnologia e mídias sociais dá andamento a uma ação judicial alegando que a lei é inconstitucional. O Tribunal Federal de Apelações do 8º Circuito com sede em St. Louis, em sua decisão, suspendeu a lei por enquanto, deferindo um pedido de liminar apresentado pela xAI. No mês passado, um juiz de primeira instância havia rejeitado o pedido de Musk para uma ordem que suspendesse a lei. A lei estadual contra a “nudificação”, que entrou em vigor em 1º de agosto, proíbe operadores de sites, desenvolvedores de software e outros de permitir que usuários criem imagens realistas retratando uma parte íntima do corpo que não apareça na foto original de um indivíduo identificável. A xAI alega que a medida restringe a liberdade de expressão protegida pela Constituição dos EUA. Minnesota e a xAI não responderam imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário. O juiz federal Donovan Frank decidiu no mês passado que a xAI não havia demonstrado que sofreria dano irreparável ao contestar a lei e afirmou que a empresa havia esperado tempo demais para solicitar uma medida cautelar. Em seu recurso, a xAI contestou a conclusão do juiz de que ela teria demorado a entrar com a ação. A empresa também afirmou que sua ferramenta Grok Imagine inclui “proteções rigorosas” contra a criação de imagens de nudez ou sexualizadas de pessoas reais. A xAI começou a processar usuários que, segundo ela, estão contornando os bloqueadores tecnológicos do Grok para criar imagens de caráter sexual de pessoas sem o consentimento delas. O Estado de Minnesota havia instado o tribunal de apelação a não bloquear a lei. O Estado afirmou ter adotado a medida este ano para combater a disseminação do que chamou de “uma quantidade impressionante de material de abuso sexual infantil gerado por produtos de IA como o Grok Imagine”.

item.title: Texans' Nico Collins set to return; Joey Porter Jr. may go for Cowboys
item.description: Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Houston Texans standout receiver Nico Collins was a full practice participant on Friday and is set to play in Sunday's home game against the Dallas Cowboys. Collins missed the past two games after hurting his hamstring in practice on Sept. 16. He was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday this week. A two-time Pro Bowl selection, Collins had seven catches for 75 yards and a touchdown in Houston's 36-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills in its season opener on Sept. 13. Collins, 27, has topped 1,000 receiving yards in each of the past three seasons. He had a career-best 1,297 yards in 2023. The 2021 third-round draft pick has 296 receptions for 4,422 yards and 25 scores in 67 career games (53 starts), all with the Texans. As expected, linebacker Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) was ruled out for Houston (0-3). Safety M.J. Stewart (knee) didn't practice Friday and also will miss the contest. Defensive ends Jadeveon Clowney (knee) and Logan Hall (knee), guard Ed Ingram (groin) and linebacker Jake Hansen (calf) are all questionable for the Texans. Houston placed running back British Brooks (hamstring) on injured reserve Friday. For Dallas (1-2), cornerback Cobie Durant and linebacker DeMarvion Overshown were both ruled out with hamstring injuries. Safety Malik Hooker (forearm) practiced in full Friday and doesn't have an injury designation after missing the previous two games. The Cowboys are also preparing cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to play Sunday. Dallas acquired him from the Pittsburgh Steelers in a trade on Wednesday. "I think we've got a really good plan that if he does play, where we'll use him and what that will look like," Dallas coach Brian Schottenheimer told reporters on Friday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Apple says it will flag AI requests for Mac data after Meta's Muse draws complaints
item.description: Apple said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Apple (AAPL.O) said on Friday that it plans to change its Mac operating system to make it more obvious when AI agents ask to access all of the data on Macs. Some users have criticized Meta's (META.O) Muse, an AI agent capable of carrying out complex tasks like canceling unused subscriptions or haggling for better prices. These people claimed the agent accessed what users believed to be private messages. On Apple's iPhones and iPads, no single app can access data inside another app by default, a technique called sandboxing. But Apple's Macs are more flexible, with a "Full Disk Access" option that allows apps such as cloud backup services to access all the data on a machine, with a user's permission. Apple on Friday said some developers were using the Full Disk Access feature in ways that could put users at risk. "Going forward, we will introduce additional controls to ensure that users who genuinely wish to grant an app this extraordinary level of access can only do so with very explicit user action," Apple wrote in a post . "As AI agents become increasingly capable and autonomous, the risks associated with this level of access will grow substantially. We are committed to ensuring users clearly understand these risks before granting such access, so they can make informed decisions about their own data and privacy." Apple's move comes after Inc magazine technology columnist Jason Aten accused Meta's Muse of reading private messages on his Mac. He said he had not enabled Full Disk Access. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone pushed back against those claims last week, saying Muse's access to Apple's Messages app is strictly opt-in. "You have to enable both Full Disk Access and the Messages connector for Muse to be able to read your Messages content," Stone wrote on social media platform X . "It can't read your Messages unless you do this. And it can be revoked at any time." Apple declined to comment beyond its post. Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Kirkland, Latham top M&A adviser rankings amid 3rd quarter slowdown
item.description: Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: Law firm Kirkland & Ellis was the lead global M&A legal adviser by deal value in the first nine months of 2026, and Latham & Watkins advised on more deals than any other firm, according to new data released Friday by LSEG. M&A deals announced in the first three quarters reached $3.9 trillion, a 28% increase compared to the same period last year and the "strongest opening period for deal making since 2021," LSEG said in its M&A legal adviser rankings. But aggregate deal value took a nosedive in the third quarter, dropping 41% compared to the second quarter of 2026, LSEG found. In the first three quarters combined, Kirkland worked on 565 deals worth $601 billion, followed by Sullivan & Cromwell with 159 deals worth $473 billion, according to LSEG's rankings of advisers on announced transactions by deal value. Latham was top-ranked by number of deals, handling 613 deals worth an overall $457 billion. Goodwin was second, advising on 587 deals worth $232 billion. Last quarter was the first time since the second quarter of 2025 that quarterly deal value dropped below $1 trillion, LSEG found. The number of mega deals -- transactions worth more than $10 billion -- and the total number of deals [USN:L6N45M0VD TEXT:"both dropped in the third quarter"]. "I don't view it as that surprising we're seeing volatility, that's been the theme the last few years," said Josh Zachariah, who leads Goodwin Procter's M&A group. Dealmakers faced headwinds in the last quarter that included stock market volatility, rising oil prices and "stubborn" inflation, Zachariah said. Paul Kukish, who serves as global co-chair of Latham's M&A and private equity practice, said in a statement he expects to see "some continued caution, especially for larger, more transformational deals, but not a uniform pause across the market" in the fourth quarter of 2026. Kukish and Zachariah both said their firms are busy with M&A work. Spokespersons for Kirkland and Sullivan & Cromwell had no immediate comment.

item.title: Coreia do Norte dispara projétil não identificado em direção ao mar na costa leste, diz governo sul-coreano
item.description: Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coreia do Norte disparou um projétil não identificado em direção ao mar, na costa leste do país, informou o Estado-Maior Conjunto da Coreia do Sul em um comunicado. O lançamento ocorreu depois que Kim Yo Jong, de Pyongyang — irmã influente do líder Kim Jong Un —, divulgou nesta sexta-feira um comunicado rejeitando a exigência de Seul de um pedido de desculpas pelas minas norte-coreanas que feriram gravemente soldados sul-coreanos na Zona Desmilitarizada, uma área fortemente fortificada entre as duas Coreias. A Coreia do Sul afirmou nesta semana que as minas norte-coreanas causaram a explosão que feriu gravemente dois soldados sul-coreanos durante uma missão de reconhecimento dentro da fronteira de 4 km de largura que se estende pela Península Coreana. A Coreia do Norte intensificou drasticamente sua hostilidade contra o Sul nos últimos anos, renegando a unificação como objetivo nacional e chamando a Coreia do Sul de seu “principal inimigo”.

item.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward sea, South Korea and Japan say
item.description: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this year that came a day after it rejected Seoul's accusation of its mines wounding soldiers.
item.dc:creator: Heejin Kim
item.content:encoded: North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the sea off its east coast on Saturday, South Korea and Japan said, its latest missile launch this year that came a day after it rejected Seoul's accusation of its mines wounding soldiers. The missile was launched from the Wonsan area at around 6.30 a.m. on Saturday (2130 GMT, Friday) and flew more than 700 kilometres (434 miles), the South Korean military said in a statement. Seoul and Washington were analysing the test for details, it added. Japan's coast guard, in an emailed statement citing the Japanese defence ministry, said the object may have been a ballistic missile and appeared to have come down, warning ships to take precautions. South Korea's military said it has raised its monitoring of any further missile tests and will share intelligence with the US and Japan . The South Korean presidential office's national security council convened an emergency meeting on Saturday to assess the situation after the missile launch, the office said in a statement. North Korea has launched missile tests on more than 10 occasions so far this year. Pyongyang has sometimes said it was testing new types of weapons systems. Some of the tests have come after North Korea protested joint military drills between Seoul and Washington. The launch came after Pyongyang's Kim Yo Jong, the powerful sister of leader Kim Jong Un, issued a [USN:L1N45O07Z TEXT:"statement"] on Friday that dismissed Seoul's demand for an apology for what it said were North Korean mines that seriously wounded South Korean soldiers in the Demilitarised Zone, a heavily fortified area between the two Koreas. South Korea said this week that North Korean mines caused the blast that seriously injured two South Korean soldiers on a reconnaissance mission inside the 4-km-wide (2.5-mile) border that stretches across the Korean Peninsula. The missile test may be an attempt by Pyongyang to draw a response from South Korea to the sister's statement, said Cheong Seong-chang, vice president at the Sejong Institute in Seoul, a research centre on North Korean affairs. North Korea may also have tested a new type of missile, he added. North Korea has sharply ramped up hostility against the South in recent years, disavowing unification as a national goal and calling South Korea its "primary foe".

item.title: Colombia canjea deuda interna por 19,8 billones de pesos
item.description: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Hacienda de Colombia informó el viernes que canjeó títulos de deuda pública interna por 19,8 billones de pesos (5.985 millones de dólares), en busca de disminuir la presión de pagos previstos para este y el próximo año. Se trata del primero de tres canjes de deuda pública local que el Gobierno planea realizar antes de finalizar el año. En la operación, el Ministerio de Hacienda recogió títulos de deuda pública interna TES con vencimiento entre 2026 y 2027, a cambio de los cuales entregó papeles con plazo entre 2027 y 2062, precisó el comunicado. Los TES son la segunda fuente de financiación interna del gasto público, después del recaudo de impuestos. El intercambio permitió reducir las amortizaciones en 2,4 billones de pesos este año y en 17,4 billones en 2027. "Esta operación busca gestionar proactivamente el riesgo de refinanciamiento, optimizar el manejo de la liquidez y dejar al país mejor posicionado para enfrentar los retos en materia fiscal y presupuestal en 2027", dijo el ministro de Hacienda, Miguel Gómez, citado en el comunicado. Con la operación, la vida media de la deuda interna representada en TES se incrementó en 0,2 años, al pasar de 9,97 a 10,17 años. El Gobierno anunció en agosto cambios en el presupuesto de gastos para este y el próximo año que mostraron un escenario peor de lo esperado por el mercado, en el que se elevó la proyección de déficit fiscal para este año a un 7,2% del PIB desde una previa de 5,3% y para 2027 se disparó hasta 9,4% del PIB frente a una de 4,5% esperada anteriormente. Según las nuevas cifras, el Gobierno aumentará su endeudamiento en 35 billones de pesos (10.581 millones de dólares) este año. "Invitamos a todos inversionistas a ser parte de la segunda ventana de intercambio que tendrá lugar el próximo 22 de octubre de 2026 y de la tercera ventana el próximo 19 de noviembre de 2026", afirmó Gómez. (1 dólar = 3.307,73 pesos)

item.title: Christa Pike, sobrevivente de execução no Tennessee, respira por aparelho, dizem advogados
item.description: A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal.
item.dc:creator: Maria Cardona
item.content:encoded: A assassina condenada Christa Pike está inconsciente, intubada e recebendo assistência respiratória por meio de um aparelho após a tentativa fracassada do Tennessee de executá-la, informaram seus advogados nesta sexta-feira, fornecendo o primeiro relato detalhado da gravidade de seu estado após a injeção letal. A equipe do hospital trabalha para salvar a vida de Pike e eliminar o pentobarbital, a droga letal, de seu organismo, afirmaram seus advogados em um pedido judicial de emergência solicitando uma ordem que exija que o Departamento Penitenciário do Tennessee preserve as provas da execução malsucedida da noite de quarta-feira. Pike continua em estado crítico, disseram seus advogados, dois dias após o Tennessee administrar duas doses de pentobarbital, sem conseguir matá-la. Ela sofreu lesões significativas nos dois braços, acrescentaram. “Em nenhum momento algum membro da equipe de execução percebeu que as linhas de infusão não estavam corretamente colocadas, que as veias haviam rompido e que o pentobarbital estava, no todo ou em parte, entrando no corpo da Sra. Pike”, afirmaram os advogados de Pike em um pedido apresentado ao Tribunal de Chancelaria do 20º Distrito Judicial do Estado do Tennessee. O documento apresenta o quadro mais completo até o momento das consequências médicas de uma tentativa de execução que, segundo o governador do Tennessee, Bill Lee, seguiu o protocolo estabelecido pelo Estado. Foi a segunda execução malsucedida do Estado neste ano. Lee suspendeu todas as outras execuções estaduais até o final de 2026 e ordenou uma investigação independente sobre o ocorrido. Os advogados de Pike afirmaram que as dificuldades da equipe de execução em administrar o medicamento estavam relacionadas ao acesso intravenoso, questão sobre a qual haviam alertado o estado e os tribunais antes da execução. Pike, de 50 anos, foi condenada pelo assassinato de sua colega de classe Colleen Slemmer, de 19 anos, em 1995, quando Pike tinha 18 anos. Ela iria se tornar a primeira mulher executada no Tennessee em mais de dois séculos.

item.title: Dodgers not talking 3-peat yet as Braves enter NLDS with confidence
item.description: LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: LOS ANGELES -- The potential road to history for the Los Angeles Dodgers begins with a reunion as the National League Division Series starts Saturday afternoon with a visit from the Atlanta Braves. Freddie Freeman has been a major postseason contributor during the Dodgers' consecutive World Series titles, and the veteran will be in the heart of the order again in a matchup against his former team. Freeman also was invaluable in the 2021 World Series when the Braves won their most recent title. Freeman joined the Dodgers as a free agent in 2022 after Atlanta moved on to Matt Olson as their first baseman. While Freeman has won three rings in five seasons, the Dodgers are trying to become the first National League club to win championships in three consecutive years. Only two American League franchises have ever done it: the New York Yankees and Oakland Athletics. The Yankees were the last to accomplish the feat when they won championships in 1998, 1999 and 2000. "We don't need to be adding any extra pressure onto ourselves," Dodgers third baseman Max Muncy said. "We've been saying that for a long time. When you talk about three-peating, you're putting that extra pressure on it that doesn't need to be there. Winning a World Series is already hard enough as it is." After returning from a biceps injury during the final week of the regular season, Shohei Ohtani will be back atop the Los Angeles order when the club's postseason run begins. Left-hander Tarik Skubal was named the Dodgers' Game 1 starter over right-hander Yoshinobu Yamamoto. Skubal arrived just before the trade deadline in a deal with the Detroit Tigers and went 5-2 with a 2.61 ERA in 10 starts for his new club. Skubal is 0-1 with a 4.91 ERA in two career starts against Atlanta, including an outing in April when he gave up two runs over seven innings in a no-decision. The Braves opened their postseason by getting past the Philadelphia Phillies in the wild-card round. Atlanta won a winner-take-all Game 3 on Thursday behind a three-run home run from Michael Harris II and a dominating day on the mound. Six pitchers kept Philadelphia in check, including staff ace Chris Sale, who recorded the final four outs. The Braves face the Dodgers after going 5-1 against them in the regular season, including a three-game home sweep in late August. "Everyone knows the Dodgers have a juggernaut, but we played well against them this year," Atlanta manager Walt Weiss said. "I know that doesn't carry a whole lot of stock. Once the playoffs begin, everybody starts at zero. The Dodgers are healthier now than they were when we saw them." Weiss has yet to name his Game 1 starter, with a left-handed opener a possibility to line up against early left-handed bats like Ohtani and Freeman. The Braves will continue to be without a pair of starters in right-hander Bryce Elder (knee) and left-hander Martin Perez (back). Like Freeman before him, Olson has emerged as a Braves leader, along with Ronald Acuna Jr. Olson hit a team-best 41 home runs in the regular season and added another in the wild-card round. Harris hit 26 home runs in the regular season and Acuna added 20 homers and 21 steals. "I think it's just kind of going out there and playing our game and knowing that ... we can compete with them and beat them," said Braves catcher Drake Baldwin, an All-Star and 2025 NL Rookie of the Year who contributed 25 home runs. --Doug Padilla, Field Level Media

item.title: US FDA extends review of Novo Nordisk's hemophilia drug over facility issues
item.description: The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA has extended its review of Novo Nordisk's (NOVOb.CO) experimental hemophilia A drug due to ongoing remediation work at a manufacturing facility, the Danish drugmaker said on Friday. Here are some details: The company was seeking the US Food and Drug Administration's approval for denecimig to treat adults and children with hemophilia A, with or without inhibitors, a rare condition that prevents the blood from clotting properly. Novo had submitted the application for denecimig in September 2025 and was expecting an FDA decision in the third quarter of 2026. While the regulator has not yet set a new timeline for its decision, Novo said the FDA did not raise any concerns regarding the safety or effectiveness data from the drug's clinical trials. The company said the manufacturing site issues do not impact any of its other medicines currently on the market. "Novo is already in the process of addressing the FDA's requests as efficiently as possible and continuing to work closely with the agency," CEO Mike Doustdar said in a statement. The company said it still aims to launch denecimig in the US in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval. The delay would not affect its 2026 financial forecast, Novo said.

item.title: Victoria Beckham apresenta vestidos transparentes e ternos oversized para a primavera/verão 2027
item.description: Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: Victoria Beckham apresentou vestidos de caimento justo, calças amplas e bolsas grandes em seu desfile de primavera/verão 2027 na Semana de Moda de Paris, nesta sexta-feira. As modelos usaram ternos oversized em tons de verde e azul, com ombros largos e acolchoados, combinados com calças fluidas que caíam sobre os saltos. Parkas curtas, marcadas na cintura, foram usadas sobre vestidos transparentes com fendas laterais e barras adornadas com pompons. Bolsas gigantes eram carregadas debaixo do braço. O negócio de moda e beleza de Victoria Beckham registrou um lucro operacional de 7,3 milhões de libras (US$9,66 milhões) em 2025, tornando-se lucrativo pela primeira vez desde sua fundação, em 2008. A receita da marca nas áreas de moda, artigos de couro, maquiagem e perfumes cresceu 15%, chegando a 129,8 milhões de libras. A marca possui uma loja principal em Londres e inaugurou sua primeira loja em Nova York no mês passado. Na Conciergerie, uma antiga prisão onde Maria Antonieta ficou detida, as modelos desfilaram diante de fileiras de convidados à luz de velas, incluindo Eva Longoria, David Beckham e os filhos do casal Romeo, Cruz e Harper. O filho mais velho dos Beckhams, Brooklyn, estava ausente. Ele também está na Semana de Moda de Paris, tendo sido visto na primeira fila do desfile da Balenciaga, na quinta-feira, com sua esposa, Nicola Peltz. Brooklyn tornou públicas, em janeiro, acusações sobre o que chamou de comportamento "controlador" de seus pais, revelando pela primeira vez uma disputa familiar. A Semana de Moda de Paris vai até terça-feira, com desfiles de moda feminina de gigantes do setor, como Hermès, Chanel e Louis Vuitton, ainda a acontecer.

item.title: Trump visa policies weigh on Columbia journalism program as admissions pause
item.description: The Trump administration's changing visa policies caused a sharp drop in international applications to Columbia University and contributed to the university pausing admissions to one of its journalism programs, four people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni, Edmund Lee
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration's changing visa policies caused a sharp drop in international applications to Columbia University and contributed to the university pausing admissions to one of its journalism programs, four people familiar with the matter said. The journalism school announced on Thursday it was pausing admissions to its Master of Arts offering to conduct a "critical evaluation," without giving further details about the reasons. Jelani Cobb, the journalism school's dean, said admissions to its Master of Arts program would pause for one year while the school reworked a degree created in 2005, when the "journalism marketplace looked different." "The dynamics of visas and all those other kinds of things were part of the consideration," Cobb told Reuters. Additionally, the department needs time to think through changes to the program, he added. The connection between the admissions pause and US visa policies has not been previously reported, nor has the length of the admissions pause. The drop in international applications shows how uncertainty over President Donald Trump's visa policies is affecting one of the preeminent US journalism institutions, which also administers the profession's highest US honor, the Pulitzer Prize. The people did not disclose the exact size of the drop in applications. Last year, the Trump administration temporarily halted new student-visa appointments, then resumed them with [USN:S0N3OK04N TEXT:"expanded screening"] of applicants' online activity, saying the checks were needed to identify potential threats to US national security. Columbia was among the universities targeted by his administration over pro-Palestinian campus protests in 2024. Last year, it agreed to [USN:FWN3TK1JE TEXT:"pay over $200 million"] to settle federal investigations and regain most of its suspended federal funding. A new rule this year also sought to limit how long foreign students and journalists could stay in the US without seeking extensions, but a [USN:L1N4560X0 TEXT:"federal judge blocked it"] before it took effect last month, calling its rationale "exceptionally weak." RELIANCE ON INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS Visa difficulties and immigration policy uncertainty have deterred prospective Columbia journalism students from abroad, the four people said, requesting anonymity to discuss its admissions. International students make up roughly half of the M.A. program's enrollment, the people said. Kaushik Raj, an Indian journalist admitted to Columbia's separate M.S. program in data journalism, was denied a US student visa last year, the Intercept reported . His rejection letter said he had not shown sufficient ties to India to establish he would return after his studies, according to the report. Geared toward mid-career journalists seeking expertise in subjects such as politics, business and science, the M.A. program is smaller than the Master of Science program aimed at students with less journalism experience. The school is not pausing the MS program. Lower enrollment has prompted changes to the M.A. program, including the combination of science and politics seminars in the 2024-25 academic year, two of the people familiar with the matter said. On Thursday, the school also announced a two-year, part-time online M.S. program. The move could allow Columbia to enroll international students without visas, but Cobb said it was unrelated to the M.A. admissions pause because the programs serve different students. CHANGING DYNAMICS OF JOURNALISM The M.A. pause comes as news organizations grapple with AI's potential to reshape how stories are produced and found, while falling search traffic piles pressure on their business. Last year, at least 3,434 journalism jobs were cut in the UK and US, according to a Press Gazette tracker . The BBC and CBS News have announced layoffs this year. Some journalists took to social media on Thursday to criticize the M.A. program as too short and too expensive. The course spans nine months and Columbia estimates the cost of attendance at $120,000 before financial aid. The year-long M.S. in Data Journalism costs about $180,000. Two of the people familiar with the matter said the financial assistance made tuition less of a deterrent because most students receive financial aid. About 80% of the students receive financial aid, including grants, loans, or scholarships from institutional, federal and private funds, according to its website. Cobb said the journalism school wants to create a new fundraising strategy for the M.A. program and is considering starting a part-time version.

item.title: Petrobras encuentra más petróleo frente a las costas del estado brasileño de Amapá
item.description: La petrolera estatal brasileña Petrobras anunció el viernes que encontro petróleo en aguas ultraprofundas frente a las costas del estado de Amapá, en una región conocida como "Margen Ecuatorial", la que considera su nueva frontera petrolera más prometedora.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La petrolera estatal brasileña Petrobras (PETR3.SA) anunció el viernes que encontro petróleo en aguas ultraprofundas frente a las costas del estado de Amapá, en una región conocida como "Margen Ecuatorial", la que considera su nueva frontera petrolera más prometedora. Según un informe presentado ante la autoridad bursátil, halló un intervalo petrolífero en el pozo Morpho, lo que supone un nuevo descubrimiento en el bloque FZA-M-59, donde ya se habían identificado hidrocarburos en agosto. El descubrimiento se realizó en un segundo yacimiento, situado a mayor profundidad en el mismo pozo del hallazgo de agosto, según la empresa. Se prevé que los trabajos en el pozo concluyan a finales de octubre, dijo el viernes a los periodistas la presidenta ejecutiva, Magda Chambriard. Petrobras perforará tres nuevos pozos en la zona para determinar si es viable la producción comercial en la cuenca de Foz do Amazonas, una zona sensible desde el punto de vista medioambiental. Foz do Amazonas comparte similitudes geológicas con las costas de Guyana, donde ExxonMobil (XOM.N) está desarrollando enormes yacimientos.

item.title: US appeals court blocks Minnesota law barring 'nudified' photos in XAI lawsuit
item.description: Elon Musk's xAI on Friday persuaded a US federal appeals court to halt Minnesota's first-in-the-nation ban on AI-generated fake nude images as the technology and social media company pursues a lawsuit alleging that the law is unconstitutional.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk's xAI on Friday persuaded a US federal appeals court to halt Minnesota's first-in-the-nation ban on AI-generated fake nude images as the technology and social media company pursues a lawsuit alleging that the law is unconstitutional. The St. Louis-based 8th US Circuit Court of Appeals in its order put the law on hold for now, granting a request for an injunction by xAI. A lower court judge last month had rejected Musk's bid for an order stopping the law. The state's anti-"nudification" law, which took effect on August 1, prohibits website operators, software developers and others from allowing users to create realistic images depicting an intimate body part that is not shown in an original photo of an identifiable individual. xAI alleges the measure restricts free speech protected by the US Constitution. Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison's office said in a statement on Friday it is disappointed by the appeals court ruling and will defend the new state law as xAI's appeal moves forward. "Minnesota's nudification ban outlaws AI technology products from generating sexual images that harm and harass people in the vilest way possible," Ellison spokesperson John Stiles said. xAI did not immediately respond to a request for comment. US District Judge Donovan Frank [USN:T5N439018 TEXT:"ruled last month"] that xAI had not shown it would suffer irreparable harm while challenging the law and said the company had waited too long to seek emergency relief. In its appeal, xAI disputed the judge's finding that it delayed bringing suit. The company also said its Grok Imagine tool includes "rigorous protections" against creating nudified or sexualized images of real people. xAI has begun [USN:L6N43H101 TEXT:"suing users"] whom it alleges are evading Grok’s technological blockers to create sexual images of people without their consent. Minnesota had urged the appeals court not to block the law. The state has said it adopted the measure this year to combat the spread of what it called a "staggering amount (of) child sexual abuse material that AI products like Grok Imagine generate."

item.title: Dois iranianos são acusados no Reino Unido por suposto plano terrorista contra comunidade judaica
item.description: A polícia britânica informou nesta sexta-feira que acusou dois cidadãos iranianos por planejarem um ataque terrorista contra a comunidade judaica no norte da Inglaterra na véspera do Yom Kippur, o dia mais sagrado do calendário judaico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A polícia britânica informou nesta sexta-feira que acusou dois cidadãos iranianos por planejarem um ataque terrorista contra a comunidade judaica no norte da Inglaterra na véspera do Yom Kippur, o dia mais sagrado do calendário judaico. Rahman Salehi, de 35 anos, e Salam Ahmadyan, de 36, foram acusados de se prepararem para cometer um ato de terrorismo ou de auxiliar outra pessoa a cometer um ato de terrorismo na sexta-feira, aniversário de um ataque fatal a uma sinagoga em Manchester no ano passado. Os dois homens teriam mantido contato com um terceiro no exterior, que poderia estar no Irã, em relação ao plano, informou a polícia. Os dois comparecerão ao Tribunal de Magistrados de Westminster, em Londres, no sábado. Detetives da unidade antiterrorismo afirmaram que não há conexão com um suposto plano separado envolvendo a base aérea da RAF Fairford, usada pelos EUA para atacar o Irã, em relação ao qual um cidadão com dupla nacionalidade britânica e iraniana foi preso na quinta-feira. Vicki Evans, da Polícia Antiterrorista (CTP), afirmou em comunicado: “Embora este incidente e a investigação sobre o incidente da RAF Fairford não tenham qualquer ligação, quero tranquilizar a população de que a CTP, em colaboração com nossos parceiros de segurança nacional, está utilizando toda a gama de nossos recursos para proteger o Reino Unido de quaisquer atos hostis.”

item.title: Colômbia relata expansão da mineração aluvial de ouro, em sua maioria ilegal
item.description: A produção de ouro aluvial na Colômbia, em sua maioria ilegal, cresceu 4,5% em área em 2025 comparado a um ano antes, atingindo 118.410 hectares, com o aumento ocorrendo principalmente em terras de comunidades afro-colombianas, segundo relatório divulgado nesta sexta-feira pelo Escritório das Nações Unidas sobre Drogas e Crime (Unodc) e pelo governo.
item.dc:creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
item.content:encoded: A produção de ouro aluvial na Colômbia, em sua maioria ilegal, cresceu 4,5% em área em 2025 comparado a um ano antes, atingindo 118.410 hectares, com o aumento ocorrendo principalmente em terras de comunidades afro-colombianas, segundo relatório divulgado nesta sexta-feira pelo Escritório das Nações Unidas sobre Drogas e Crime (Unodc) e pelo governo. O aumento de 5.100 hectares em relação a 2024 marcou o terceiro ano consecutivo de crescimento, informou o Unodc à Reuters. “Setenta e cinco por cento (da produção de ouro aluvial) é ilegal, 21% possui licenças técnicas e/ou ambientais e 4% está em processo de legalização”, afirmou o relatório. O ouro aluvial é encontrado nos leitos de rios e córregos e é normalmente extraído por meio de métodos de separação baseados na gravidade, como garimpo com bateia, canalização e dragagem e lavagem mecanizadas. Como as técnicas exigem relativamente pouco equipamento e investimento, os depósitos aluviais costumam atrair garimpeiros de pequena escala, ilegais ou informais. Quase metade dos 32 departamentos da Colômbia apresentou indícios de exploração de ouro aluvial no ano passado, com 61% do aumento ocorrendo em terras afro-colombianas. A produção de ouro aluvial também foi detectada em 30 reservas indígenas, segundo o relatório. Indígenas e negros colombianos têm sido, historicamente, mais propensos a serem vítimas do conflito que já dura seis décadas no país, a sofrer com a pobreza e a viver em áreas mais isoladas. Quase metade das áreas onde a produção ocorreu são zonas onde a mineração não é permitida, incluindo reservas florestais e parques nacionais. De acordo com fontes de segurança, a mineração ilegal de ouro é a segunda maior fonte de financiamento para grupos armados ilegais, depois do tráfico de drogas. A mineração ilegal de ouro está destruindo florestas e poluindo rios com produtos químicos, afirmou a ministra de Minas e Energia, Maria Nohemi Arboleda, durante a apresentação do relatório. Setenta e nove municípios com mineração aluvial de ouro em 2025 também apresentavam cultivo de coca. “Quase metade da área com mineração aluvial de ouro também possui plantações de coca. É uma combinação, um negócio perfeito. Este não é um debate sobre mineração. É um confronto entre o Estado e as economias criminosas que usam o ouro para financiar a violência”, disse Arboleda. Arboleda afirmou que os países que compram ouro deveriam exigir sistemas de rastreabilidade para verificar se o metal tem origem legal.

item.title: France held to 1-1 draw as Italy dampen Zidane's home debut
item.description: Zinedine Zidane's perfect start to life as France manager came to an end when his side were held to a 1-1 draw by Italy in their Nations League meeting at the Stade de France on Friday, where the hosts went down to 10 men in the closing minutes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Zinedine Zidane's perfect start to life as France manager came to an end when his side were held to a 1-1 draw by Italy in their Nations League meeting at the Stade de France on Friday, where the hosts went down to 10 men in the closing minutes. France had won 1-0 away to both Turkey and Belgium in Zidane's first two games, but after Michael Olise put the French ahead 10 minutes after the break, Alessandro Bastoni levelled for Italy. "I'm very disappointed for the players because we deserved better," Zidane told TF1. "But I'm proud of them, the effort, the pressing, they were exemplary." Zidane's first home game in charge came against the same opposition he had faced in his final international match as a player. That 2006 World Cup final, which Italy won on penalties, will forever be remembered for Zidane's headbutt to the chest of Marco Materazzi which led to his red card in extra-time. France dominated possession early on, pinning the visitors back in their own half, but the first chance fell to Italy when Moise Kean failed to find the net from inside the six-yard box, firing straight at keeper Mike Maignan. For all France's slick passing and attacking play, Olise's deflected cross clipping the crossbar was the closest they came to scoring in the opening half and before the break Italy created more danger, with Davide Frattesi's goalbound shot taking a touch off a French player and going out for a corner. "We knew it would be a very difficult match," Italy coach Roberto Mancini told RAI. "But we did well to allow them very little in terms of chances, even if they had more possession." France finally put Gianluigi Donnarumma under pressure shortly after the interval. The Italian keeper parried away Desire Doue's shot from distance and recovered in time to block Ousmane Dembele's follow-up effort from point-blank range. Donnarumma was back in action moments later, diving to deny Olise's curling strike as France came out for the second half all guns blazing and they found the opener from a free kick move. Rayan Cherki tapped the ball to Olise who curled an unstoppable shot in off the bar but France failed to put Italy away and a defensive lapse allowed the visitors in for a 68th minute equaliser. France attempted to play the ball out from the back but Lucas Da Cunha failed to control a pass and Bastoni pounced and drove forward before firing past Maignan. Eduardo Camavinga forced Donnarumma into a flying save late on before Dayot Upamecano received a second yellow card to leave France down to 10 men for the final five minutes. DE BRUYNE DOUBLE Belgium beat Turkey 3-0 in the other Group A1 game, with Kevin De Bruyne putting the hosts ahead in the 10th minute after a one-two with Dodi Lukebakio. Lukebakio twice hit the post before De Bruyne scored again on the hour mark from the edge of the box. Romelu Lukaku came off the bench to replace Lukebakio and wrapped up the win 14 minutes from time with his 94th international goal. France lead the group on seven points, one ahead of Belgium. Italy are on four points with Turkey yet to get off the mark. DZEKO'S LAST DANCE Edin Dzeko, Bosnia's most-capped player and all-time leading scorer, made his 152nd and final appearance, in a 1-1 draw at home to Sweden. Viktor Gyokeres put Sweden ahead in the 61st minute, becoming the first player to score in six consecutive Nations League games. Two minutes later, Dzeko was replaced to a standing ovation from the crowd and applause from both sets of players, with his teammates giving the 40-year-old a guard of honour. Kerim Alajbegovic equalised 10 minutes from time. In the other Group B4 game, Robert Lewandowski netted a hat-trick as Poland powered past 10-man Romania 6-0. The turning point came midway through the first half when Radu Dragusin was sent off for a foul on Lewandowski and the Polish captain converted the resulting spot kick. Lewandowski added another two minutes after the break, and the 38-year-old scored his third and Poland's final goal four minutes from time.
